Case: records that cannot name the spec they were made against
Asserts: A3
Home: reachable
Records: 3
Expect: finding
Findings: 3
Why: The spec home is READABLE here, so nothing about reachability is at stake
  and A2 must stay silent. Each record fails to name a spec in a different
  way - no `Spec commit` line at all, a blank one, and a placeholder - and all
  three are the same failure: a record that cannot say which spec it was made
  against cannot show it was made against the live one. Three records rather
  than one because a detector that catches only the missing line would still
  produce "a finding" from a single-record case.
